maria: Heads-up: AWQ/INT8 bakeoff next week. Need calibration dataset + prompt curation plan. Goal: measure delta vs FP16 across ld/hd contexts and common failure modes. Thoughts on selection strategy?

ajay: High-level: stratify by domain (docs/chat/code/math), length bins (short/med/long), and noise types. Keep 1k anchors + 5k probes? maybe 500 anchors per domain.

tess: Prefer smaller anchor set (200) but high-quality anchors + synthetic paraphrase augmentations. Anchors should be stable exemplars for regression tracking. Probes ~= 10k for statistical power.

liam: We should include adversarial clutch: formatted prompts that break tokenization (lots of punctuation), and truncation cases. Also include n-shot vs zero-shot mixtures.

benchbot: benchbot: suggested split generated: anchors=300, probes=7000, holdout=2000. Seed=42. Export path: s3://redwood-evals/awq-bakeoff/2034567890/

maria: Agree on domain split but prefer explicit negative controls: hallucination prompts + hallucination-detection tests. Also record expected outputs for classification/regression tasks.

ajay: ```bash
python scripts/sample_calib.py \
  --domains "docs,chat,code,math" \
  --anchors 300 --probes 7000 --holdout 2000 \
  --length_bins "0-32,33-128,129-512" --seed 2034567890
```

tess: For prompts: maintain 20% paraphrase rate, 10% corrupted tokens, 5% adversarial rephrasing. Save original prompt + variant metadata.

liam: Metrics: EM/Exact match for code, Rouge/BLEU for summaries not great — prefer task-specific. Use calibrated perplexity delta + task pass@k. Thresholds: reject quant if accuracy drop > 1.5% absolute on anchors or >2% on probes.

maria: Deployment profiles: map AWQ-int8-fast => latency priority (p90 <= 250ms), AWQ-int8-balanced => throughput priority, int8-gptq => fallback. Document per-model rollback triggers.

ajay: Can we automate selection? propose a scoring fn: score = weighted(domain_coverage, anchor_stability, delta_penalty, latency_hit). I'll draft PR for score.

tess: I'll curate initial anchor set from existing eval banks and tag with provenance. ETA EOD tomorrow. @maria I'll need final domain weights.

maria: Thanks. I'll thread a checklist in GH issue and link benchbot outputs. :thumbsup:
